rule: A strategy is VALIDATED only if every applicable gate is PASS. N/A is ignored. Any FAIL or UNVERIFIED blocks validation and leaves ROI/CLV/profit/reward blank.

gates.name: Official provenance
gates.rule: Every numeric input traces to an allowlisted official NBA/league URL with a retrieval date.

gates.name: Data completeness
gates.rule: All fields required by the strategy are present and verified; no blank/unverified inputs.

gates.name: Minimum sample size
gates.rule: n >= 200 independent settled observations before any strategy-level performance claim.

gates.name: Out-of-sample evaluation
gates.rule: Evaluation data must not have been used to build or calibrate the model.

gates.name: Significance after multiple testing
gates.rule: Permutation test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q < 0.05 over the full tested family.

gates.name: Skill-vs-luck (luck removal)
gates.rule: Positive holdout Brier skill score AND exact binomial p < 0.05 on holdout winner accuracy.

gates.name: Economic validity
gates.rule: Verified official market odds / vig available so edge, CLV and net ROI can be computed.

gates.name: Parlay / prop correlation guard
gates.rule: Leg correlations measured from official data; dependent legs explicitly modelled (not assumed independent).

gates.name: Walk-forward stability
gates.rule: At least 3 chronological out-of-sample folds, all with non-negative skill.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.rule: All published numbers regenerated by committed scripts from committed raw official snapshots.
